senses.gloss:
m. (-रः) f. (-रा or -रिः-री)
A cascade, a water-fall.
f. (-री)
A river.
E.
झॄ to waste or decay, affix अप्, fem. affix टाप्, इन् or ङीष्; also निर्झर.

r. 6th cl. (झर्चति)
1 To say.
2 To blame; to abuse or menace; also झर्छ, झर्ज, &c.

r. 6th cl. (झर्छति)
1 To say.
2 To blame, to abuse or menace; also झर्च.

r. 6th cl. (झर्जति)
1 To say, to speak.
2 To censure, to blame.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (झर्झति झर्झयति)
1 To speak or say.
2 To censure or reprove.
r. 1st cl. (झर्झति)
To kill or hurt.

mf. (-रः-री)
A sort of drum.
m. (-रः)
1 The Kali yug, the present Yug or age of the world.
2 The name of a river.
f. (-रा)
A whore.
n. (-रं)
A sound as of splashing or dropping.
E.
झर्झ an imitative sound like that of water splashing, &c. and र what makes, from रा with ड affix, or झर्झ to censure, and अरन् Uṇādi aff.

mf. (-रः-री)
A tabor player, a drummer.
E.
झर्झर a cymbal, affix अण्; also with ठक् affix झार्झरिक.

m. (-कः)
The Kali yug.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-कः)
1 The body.
2 A country.
3 A picture.
E.
झर्झ to injure or destroy, ईकन् affix, and र inserted.
